Class GoogleGenAiClientConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.langchain4j.googlegenai.GoogleGenAiClientConfiguration
@ConfigurationProperties("langchain4j.google-gen-ai") public final class GoogleGenAiClientConfiguration extends Object
Configures the Google Gen AI Client shared by the Google Gen AI models: the Gemini API with an API key, or Vertex AI with a project, a location and the application's GoogleCredentials.
Since:
2.4.0
